en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard. The front shows a long Romanesque cathedral façade with arched windows, colonnades, statues on the upper level, and a tall bell tower with a spire and cross. A decorative street lamp stands prominently in the foreground along a stone-paved street. The lower margin of the image bears Hungarian captions identifying the location. The reverse side has a green Hungarian postage stamp, a circular postmark, printed postcard layout lines, handwritten Hungarian address to Budapest, and a short handwritten message.
